profile.facility_type_note: Part of Digital Realty's Silicon Valley (Santa Clara/San Jose area) data center campus, one of the company's largest US clusters. Two facilities in this group carry independent historic significance: 360 Spear Street and 365 Main Street in San Francisco are separate, well known carrier hotel buildings; 365 Main Street was the site of a widely covered July 2007 power outage that took down major web services including Craigslist and other sites hosted there, later becoming a Digital Realty/Digital Realty-heritage asset. SJC10 is documented at 1100 Space Park Drive per Digital Realty's own site.

reading.body:
Digital Realty's SJC34 campus sits in Santa Clara County, part of a Silicon Valley cluster that includes the company's historic carrier hotel buildings at 365 Main Street and 360 Spear Street in San Francisco. The facility's individual critical IT power capacity is not confirmed from a tier-1 source in this research pass. Santa Clara County hosts 103 mapped data center facilities, of which 11 publish power figures totaling 365 MW.

This campus does not appear in the state's top tier of published capacity. Twelve facilities in California publish higher megawatt figures than SJC34. The operator's own specification page confirms the address at 2820 Northwestern Parkway in Santa Clara but does not disclose the critical IT load in a form this research captured.

Without published power specifications, SJC34 cannot be sized against the binding constraint on AI scaling. To assess whether this campus matters to AI infrastructure, a reader would need to obtain the facility's critical IT megawatts directly from Digital Realty or from a tier-1 source with access to that figure. The location within Silicon Valley indicates proximity to cloud tenants and interconnection fabric, but that advantage cannot be quantified against capacity or availability without the power specification.
